LEX_003 — Settlement status and proposed terms

We acknowledge the claimant’s acceptance of the proposed settlement amount of INR 7,000,000, with confidentiality preserved. Our client’s approval remains unverified and must be checked independently; we do not represent that approval has been obtained.

Subject to confirmation of our client’s authority and execution of a mutually agreed settlement agreement, the proposed terms are payment of INR 7,000,000 to the claimant and preservation of confidentiality. Payment timing, release scope, and any procedural steps to conclude the dispute remain to be agreed. Please provide a draft agreement reflecting these terms for review.
